source_policy: CrossWire module text + its own SWORD KJV verse index; HelloAO only when entire SWORD chapter lacks verse records or for John Gill
caveats: Binary index equality establishes identical stored SWORD record, not text-level coverage of every verse.
KJV is the verse numbering system; the commentary does not contain any translation verse texts.
A SWORD verse-1 entry can include front matter and section text; marked as possible.
No source-text substitution or cross-edition merging is performed.
HelloAO fallback operates at the chapter level; absent per-verse indexes remain absent.
Source content may include historical HTML/OSIS and is not safe to render unsanitized.
